The provided CLI hashes must be the actual root acceptance and stop SHA-256 values; missing or mismatched predecessor bytes reject before SSH.
This conditional source review does not authorize or claim S5 admission, launch, fit, or quality.

predecessor_gate.acceptance_binds: Successful native exit, distinct successful terminal verifier, actual verification digest format, selected/epoch-2 model hashes, and common tensor fingerprint.
predecessor_gate.acceptance_sha256: caller-supplied and checked against exact file bytes before preparation/SSH
predecessor_gate.remote_recheck: Preflight rehashes both predecessor byte sequences, requires S4 acceptance schema/status/run/recipe/native invocation again, exact stop equality and empty population, and verifies both accepted units are not-found before S5 output creation/launch.
predecessor_gate.stop_checks: Exact before/stop/after unit set must match the accepted native and verifier identities; both before snapshots must be successful exited invocations, stop commands return 0, both after snapshots must be not-found/inactive/dead with empty InvocationID, and populated campaign map must be empty.
predecessor_gate.stop_sha256: caller-supplied and checked against exact file bytes before preparation/SSH

resource_and_fit_preflight.execution_boundary: The generator will create the remote submission and then SSH only if executed with real predecessor hashes; source review did not execute it. This is a conditional single S5 admission, not an actual admission or fit result.
resource_and_fit_preflight.fresh_gpu_gate: Rechecks the recipe's selected GPU UUID and free-memory floor while preserving foreign GPU processes.
resource_and_fit_preflight.fresh_parent_scope: Reuses the reviewed live parent-slice gate: exact 2-core/18-GB-high/20-GB-max/swap-zero settings, fresh memory headroom, bounded scan of all campaign cgroup.procs descendants and empty population.
resource_and_fit_preflight.fresh_path_gates: Rejects an existing S5 output/run/unit or global stop marker, validates physical source/split paths, rehashes all 164 source files, checks current split identity, registered data stat identity, disk headroom and persistent scratch.
resource_and_fit_preflight.recipe_gate: Binds S5 run/seed and strict FP32/Muon flags, full 3-epoch fit, checkpoint epoch 2, training state save and no evaluation during fit; rejects profile/max-batch truncation.
